content.text: Can you play the lottery online? A lottery is a type of game where players buy numbered tickets, and prizes are given to the holders of numbers drawn at random. Lotteries are considered to be games of chance, and are therefore treated differently to real money online casinos. There are two ways to play the online lottery in the U.S. In regions where online lottery games are supported directly by the state lottery, you can use the authority's dedicated platform. Through a website or mobile app, you can buy tickets and play games like keno safely from anywhere in the state you have a connection. The alternative is to use a lottery courier. A lottery courier will buy tickets from a licensed lottery retailer for you, allowing you to manage how much you want to spend and what numbers you want to pick. You will receive any winnings online. However, it was Puerto Rico that established the first modern U.S. lottery operation in 1934 before New Hampshire launched the inaugural mainland U.S. lottery in 1964. More than 45 states in the U.S., plus the jurisdictions of Puerto Rico, the Virgin Islands, and Washington DC, now operate some kind of lottery in 2026. While no national lottery operating body exists, Mega Millions and Powerball games are offered in most U.S. jurisdictions, effectively providing a national lottery service. When did the online lottery start? Following questions from stakeholders in Illinois and New York, the U.S. Department of Justice’s Office of Legal Counsel considered whether online lottery tickets should be included under the Wire Act of 1960. The Counsel ruled that the Wire Act only applied to sports gambling, allowing Illinois to launch the first online lottery service in 2012. How to play online lottery Playing online lottery games is straightforward, and millions of players across the U.S. enjoy this type of gambling. Get clued up on how to play two of the most popular online lottery games below: Playing Mega Millions online Launched initially as The Big Game in 1996, the Mega Millions was first drawn in September 1996. Only six states were initially included in its draws: Georgia, Illinois, Maryland, Michigan, Massachusetts, and Virginia. The game operates under the Multi-State Lottery Association (MUSL) and costs just $2 per play. The biggest payout so far occurred in August 2023, where one lucky player won $1.602 billion. You can play Mega Millions by visiting a lottery retailer or purchasing a ticket through a licensed online service, choosing five numbers between 1 and 70 for the white balls. Then, you pick a number between 1 and 25 for the gold Mega Ball. You win a jackpot by matching all six numbers. You can watch Mega Millions draws every Tuesday and Friday at 23:00 ET. Playing Powerball online Powerball, formed in 1992 as part of the MUSL, holds the record for the largest jackpot total in U.S. history, with a California player hitting $2.04b in November 2022. Powerball draws are held every Monday, Wednesday, and Saturday at 10:59 Eastern. Like Mega Millions, a regular Powerball ticket costs just $2. To play Powerball, you have to select five numbers between 1 and 69 for the white balls and one number between 1 and 26 for the red 'Powerball'. You can choose the numbers by visiting your local lottery retailer or selecting them through any online lottery service in your state. Learning how to buy lottery tickets online is a simple process, as the majority of games and providers follow the same template: 1 Pick your platform Your choice of online lottery platform is determined by your location. In some U.S. states, you can visit the official state lottery provider's website and buy tickets directly. In other regions, you can use lottery courier service websites and apps like Jackpot, Jackpocket, and theLotter to order tickets. 2 Install the app If using an online lottery courier service, install the relevant app to your mobile device to ensure easier purchasing and ticket tracking. These apps can be downloaded directly from the operator's website, or from the Apple App Store or Google Play Store. 3 Select a game Browse the available games and variations, then pick your favourite. Online lotteries often offer scratch cards and games like keno, as well as traditional formats. 4 Pick your numbers Either manually pick your lottery numbers, or use the 'auto-select' function to generate a random selection of numbers and populate your ticket. 5 Complete your purchase Once happy with your number choices, confirm your ticket and finalize your order. If using a lottery courier, an agent of the provider will then purchase a ticket on your behalf from an authorised retailer and upload a scan of your ticket to your online account. 6 Check your ticket Keep track of your ticket via your online profile on the state lottery website or the online lottery courier app. You will usually receive a notification if you win, but certain draws are also televised weekly. What are scratch-offs? Scratch-offs are a type of lottery game where players can win cash instantly by revealing matching symbols. Otherwise known as lottery scratchers, the online version of the game sees players click on the hidden icons or use an 'auto-reveal' function instead of physically scratching the covering off their ticket. Sometimes available at real money online casinos and sweepstakes casinos as well as at online lotteries, 'Scratch & Win' scratch cards are popular because of their potential for large instant prizes. However, online scratch-offs — like their traditional convenience store predecessors — are still games of chance and there is no guarantee of a return when playing scratch-offs online for real money. Where does lottery revenue go? The use of lottery revenue varies from state to state and depends on what game you’re playing. If you’re participating in a national lottery like Mega Millions or Powerball, around half of the revenue goes back into the lottery prize pool. Most of the remaining funds go towards lottery administration costs and retailer commissions. Each state will decide how to distribute lottery revenues, but most use these funds to improve areas like education, infrastructure, health services, nature protection, and arts. You can find out how your state utilises lottery revenues by visiting the official state lottery site. What are online lottery subscriptions? An online lottery subscription automatically buys tickets with your chosen numbers, taking funds out of your online wallet to do so. You can set up your subscription to purchase tickets for weekly draws, or wait for when prize pools hit a certain amount. What are online lottery courier services? As already discussed, third-party companies like Jackpocket, theLotter, and Jackpot use online lottery courier services to provide you with online lottery tickets. Effectively, when you buy your tickets online, the lottery retailers will purchase your ticket in person. The courier will buy the ticket and collect any winnings, providing everything to you online. While you can buy tickets online, you still need to be in the state where the lottery sales take place to purchase tickets legally. Your online lottery courier will use geolocation technology to verify you are in the correct state to play. Legal online lottery ticket sites vs. illegal courier An illegal lottery courier may offer you tickets for all the same U.S. games as a legal platform, but there are no guarantees this site will provide valid tickets. Additionally, governing bodies in the U.S. can’t offer protections if it doesn’t. Illegal lottery couriers may allow you to buy tickets for lottery draws worldwide. However, you can only legally purchase tickets for the state where you are based and any licensed multi-state draws. We do not recommend using an illegal lottery courier.
